deviations.what: fedavg job stopped with "CUDA error: an illegal memory access was encountered" in ids2018 alpha=100 seed=805, arm rehearsal (nonstat of that cell was saved). The user confirmed that another GPU job had been started on the same machine. fedprox, scaffold and median jobs ran on unaffected.
deviations.action: Resumed at 03:1x BST with the same command and settings check (final_eval.py refuses to resume into a file written with different settings); only the unfinished arms of the cell are repeated. To catch up, fedavg is resumed as three parallel single-dataset jobs (ids2018 resume, cicids, unsw), each writing its own agg/fedavg_<ds>.json, as the protocol allows parallel jobs. After completion, the affected cell (ids2018, alpha=100, seed=805, all three arms) is rerun from scratch into a separate file and compared with the saved results.

crash_verification.cell: ids2018 alpha=100 seed=805 (fedavg), arms nonstat, rehearsal, cda
crash_verification.method: rerun from scratch into checkpoints/agg_crashcheck/fedavg_ids2018_s805.json and compared field by field with the saved results (timing ignored) by compare_crash_cell.py
crash_verification.result: all three arms and the concept record identical, bit for bit
